
```lark
?atom: NUMBER          -> num
     | "ture"          -> true
     | "false"         -> false
     | "(" expr ")"
```

It seems the grammar is expecting the string `"ture"` to evaluate to `true`, which is incorrect. It should be `"true"`.
